research_question: Across a frozen fifteen-task busy-session benchmark with five cumulative changes, does an exact approved card preserve quality through a Terra-to-Luna handoff while reducing raw input and end-to-end provider cost relative to full accumulated history?

release_rules.quality: For both trajectories, the approved-card minus full-history one-sided lower bound must be at least -0.10 for the P3-P5 mean and separately at P3, P4, and P5.
release_rules.critical: Approved-card boundary violations must be zero and card collapses may not exceed full-history collapses.
release_rules.input: Approved-card input, including advisor allocation, must be at least 50 percent below full-history input in both trajectories.
release_rules.cost: The upper endpoint of the paired 95 percent cost-difference interval must be below zero in both trajectories.

switch_resilience_rule: Support requires a card-protection point estimate of at least 0.10 and a one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero. This endpoint does not change the release gate.
